name: dev-mesh
description: Shared-workspace coordination and local observability for multi-Agent development.

interface.shortDescription: Coordinate shared workspaces and inspect local collaboration.
interface.longDescription: Use bounded Runs and Claims to coordinate shared Git workspaces, then inspect authority, contention, work results, and collaboration flows with the local Dev Mesh Console.
defaultPrompt: Coordinate this shared Git workspace before making changes.
Inspect current Dev Mesh authority and collaboration diagnostics.
Open the local Dev Mesh Console and explain the active coordination state.
